dependencyGroups.proposedBoundary: Shared report/review widgets with ATLAS shell outside

VOID/private/malformed/missing data returns same not-found; no raw session/owner/storage/admin fields; preserve historical report and public token resolution.

dependencyGroups.notes: Do not expose Prisma or database barrel to ATLAS routes/browser/machine. Existing completion mints HOUSE ownership; ATLAS external/new issuance cannot silently create Ten Kings house inventory. No schema or root-lock edit.

No duplicate SAM deployment, model/GPU fallback or package copy. Exact artifact/model/checkpoint/GPU/determinism/learning policies remain admission requirements for new work.

dependencyGroups.proposedBoundary: ATLAS workspace entry/build and CI path closure

sharedDataRules: Keep current authoritative records/storage references; no copying, dual writes, card remint or automatic historical migration.
Current source has no complete ATLAS product/assignment discriminator. Establish exact server-owned assignment and stable legacy-subject mapping before any private read or write.

A wrapper around a broad DB credential is not database isolation. Before live use, verify least-privilege DB/storage/provider grants or a narrow authenticated adapter boundary; unavailable scope blocks rollout.
The adapter must not expose transaction objects, Prisma models, arbitrary filters, raw SQL or broad admin tokens.
No schema edits here; coordinate any future assignment/issuer/adapter schema with the existing card writer and Vault owner.

humanSession.writes: Exact Origin plus session-bound CSRF token; no state-changing GET
humanSession.identity: Server-owned issuer/audience, expiry/revocation, role roster and assignment; shared identity federation only through explicit mapping, never a copied Ten Kings token
humanSession.freshApproval: Verify fresh trained-human assurance, roster and exact card/run/revision/package; separate certification review and trusted-learning purposes

machineSession.transport: Short-lived server-to-server capability token; never browser cookie or human bearer

authDesign.publicSession: Customer/public scripts share the staff browser origin; path cookies only scope delivery. Every staff API requires independently valid staff identity, role/assignment and CSRF. Customer sessions are never staff credentials.
authDesign.localState: Legacy browser localStorage and loopback pairings remain on collect.tenkings.co; drain/export and deliberately re-pair after approved cutover. Do not transfer bearer tokens.

machineRouteProposal.rule: One exact tool registration per reviewed contract; no arbitrary tool name or proxy catch-all. Offline contract schemas are not authenticated live APIs. New network/auth/storage/provider implementations and owner-approved pilot are required.

signals: human review wait and approval failure
releaseAndMonitoringDesign.redaction: No customer/owner/phone/payment data, credentials, signed URLs, raw storage keys, device secrets or raw provider payloads in public logs/health.
releaseAndMonitoringDesign.rollback: Pause new ATLAS work; drain/reconcile; select retained compatible ATLAS artifact and explicit capture routing. Keep issued records/URLs. App rollback does not undo DB/provider/DNS/auth/email changes; no retired worker fallback.
